G01_SHIRT_OVERVIEW.use: Broad first-top question about what it looks like, including material, physical details, and fit.

G02_SHIRT_LIKES.use: Broad first-top question about what the character likes about it and how it could be worn.

G03_SHIRT_WARDROBE.use: Broad first-top question about clothes already owned, what need it fills, and likely use.

G04_SHIRT_REPLACEABILITY.use: Broad first-top request for an overall evaluation of how easy, hard, or difficult the item would be to replace or obtain an equivalent later; includes semantic paraphrases, not only the canonical instructed wording.

G05_HOODIE_OVERVIEW.use: Broad second-top question about what it looks like, including material, physical details, and fit.

G06_HOODIE_LIKES.use: Broad second-top question about what the character likes about it and how it could be worn.

G07_HOODIE_WARDROBE.use: Broad second-top question about clothes already owned, what need it fills, and likely use.

G08_HOODIE_REPLACEABILITY.use: Broad second-top request for an overall evaluation of how easy, hard, or difficult the item would be to replace or obtain an equivalent later; includes semantic paraphrases, not only the canonical instructed wording.

G09_CURRENT_PREFERENCE.use: Special broad disclosure only for an explicit overall request about what the character personally wants/leans toward or a statement that the choice should depend on the character’s own preference.

BC_SPC01_SHIRT_TYPE.use: What the first top is / garment type.

BC_SPC02_SHIRT_COLOR.use: Color or shade of the first top.

BC_SPC03_SHIRT_MATERIAL.use: Material composition of the first top.

BC_SPC04_SHIRT_MATERIAL_FEEL.use: Feel, softness, weight, or thickness of the first top material.

BC_SPC05_SHIRT_PATTERN.use: Pattern or stripe orientation of the first top.

BC_SPC06_SHIRT_BUTTONS.use: Color or appearance of the first top buttons.

BC_SPC07_SHIRT_COLLAR.use: Collar characteristics of the first top.

BC_SPC09_SHIRT_WORK_USE.use: How the first top could be worn for work.

BC_SPC10_SHIRT_CASUAL_USE.use: How the first top could be worn casually.

BC_SPC11_SHIRT_COLOR_MATCHING.use: What colors or clothes the first top matches with.

BC_SPC12_SHIRT_SEASON_USE.use: Use of the first top across seasons / throughout the year.

BC_SPC13_SHIRT_LAYERING.use: How the first top can be layered in colder seasons.

BC_SPC14_SHIRT_PRACTICALITY.use: Why the first top is practical or easy to style.

BC_SPC15_SHIRT_FORMAL_CASUAL.use: Whether the first top works for both dressier/work and casual situations.

BC_SPC16_SHIRT_POLISHED.use: Whether or why the first top can look neat or well dressed.

BC_SPC17_SHIRT_TIMELESS.use: Whether or why the first top has a classic style that stays in style.

BC_SPC18_SHIRT_EXISTING.use: Whether the character already owns similar button-up shirts.

BC_SPC19_SHIRT_WARDROBE_GOAL.use: The character's clothing goal related to classic, simple, easy-to-match clothes.

BC_SPC20_SHIRT_REPLACEABILITY.use: Narrow factual availability/existence follow-up about whether another similar button-up could probably be found or bought later; not an overall evaluation of replacement difficulty.

BC_SPC21_SHIRT_INVESTMENT.use: Why the first top is considered a long-term investment.

BC_SPC22_HOODIE_TYPE.use: What the second top is / garment type.

BC_SPC25_HOODIE_MATERIAL_FEEL.use: Feel, softness, flexibility, or general thickness of the hoodie material/fabric itself; use SPC26 instead when the referent is the inside/interior/lining.

BC_SPC26_HOODIE_LINING.use: What the inside, interior, inner layer, or lining of the hoodie is like, including how that inside layer feels, how soft it is, or how thick it is.

BC_SPC29_HOODIE_LOGO.use: Size, appearance, noticeability, or location of the hoodie logo.

BC_SPC30_HOODIE_HOME_USE.use: How the hoodie could be worn at home or while working from home.

BC_SPC31_HOODIE_OUTDOOR_USE.use: How the hoodie could be worn outside / for casual outings.

BC_SPC32_HOODIE_COLD_WEATHER.use: Use of the hoodie in fall, winter, or cold weather.

BC_SPC33_HOODIE_COMFORT.use: How comfortable, warm, or soft the hoodie is.

BC_SPC34_HOODIE_ELEVATED_STYLE.use: Why the hoodie feels or looks a little nicer than a basic hoodie.

BC_SPC35_HOODIE_EXISTING_COLORS.use: Colors of most hoodies the character already owns.

BC_SPC36_HOODIE_UNIQUENESS.use: Why the hoodie feels more unique than the character's other casual clothes.

BC_SPC37_HOODIE_REPLACEABILITY.use: Narrow factual availability/existence follow-up about whether the same or a similar hoodie has been/could be found, seen, or bought again; not an overall evaluation of replacement difficulty.

BC_SPC38_HOODIE_REGRET.use: Why the character might regret leaving the hoodie behind.

BC_SPC39_SAME_PRICE.use: Whether the two tops are around the same price.

BC_SPC40_ONLY_ONE.use: Why the character plans to choose only one top.

BC_SPC41_WHY_UNDECIDED.use: Concise reason the character is having difficulty choosing.

BC_SPC42_WHICH_MORE_FORMAL.use: Which top is better for work or dressier situations.

BC_SPC44_WHICH_MORE_VERSATILE.use: Which top works in more situations / is more versatile.

BC_SPC45_WHICH_WEAR_MORE.use: Which top the character expects to wear more, including near-term versus year-round use.

BC_SPC46_WHICH_HARDER_REPLACE.use: Which top is harder to find again or replace.

BC_SPC47_CURRENT_PREFERENCE.use: Short direct answer about which top the character likes a little more right now.

BC_SPC48_REGRET_COMPARISON.use: Which top the character would regret not getting more.

BC_DEC01_HOODIE.use: finalRecommendationEnabled=true and participant clearly recommends the hoodie with no unresolved information request.

BC_DEC02_SHIRT.use: finalRecommendationEnabled=true and participant clearly recommends the shirt with no unresolved information request.

BC_CTL01_ONE_QUESTION.use: Two or more independent questions / distinct information dimensions in one turn.

BC_CTL02_CLARIFY_ITEM.use: Requested information is clear but item is unresolved, OR same item-specific detail is requested for both tops and would require two separate recordings.

BC_CTL03_CLARIFY_DETAIL.use: The participant gives an in-scope comment or opinion without a new actionable information request, or the referenced item is clear but the requested information cannot be determined.

BC_CTL04_ASR_RETRY.use: Input is too incomplete/corrupted to reconstruct reliably.

BC_CTL05_OUT_OF_SCOPE.use: Understandable input is unrelated to choosing/discussing the two tops.

BC_CTL06_FINAL_CHOICE.use: finalRecommendationEnabled=true and the participant attempts a recommendation but does not clearly select exactly one top, including both/neither/ambiguous.

BC_CTL07_CONTINUE_ASKING.use: A clear recommendation is given before final recommendations are enabled and there is no unresolved information question in the same turn.
